newsitem.title: ARGENTINA: Argentine bank association to launch credit-line.
newsitem.headline: Argentine bank association to launch credit-line.

text.p: Argentina's association of provincial banks ABAPRA is going to launch a credit line of $500 million to small and medium-sized firms, the head of the financial organization said Monday.

"All the banks that make up ABAPRA have agreed to launch a credit line of $500 million for the small- and medium-sized firms that plan to hire people, so they will benefit from lower interest rates," said Ruben Beraja, the head of ABAPRA, according to the state news agency Telam.
"This is a response to a problem in society. We consider it necessary and pertinent to take an initiative like this," said Beraja.
Small- and medium-sized Argentine firms often complain about the difficulties of accessing bank credit.
